ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels. Dark pixels dominate the central mass, while high-intensity pixels are localized at the distal tips and lower trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located at the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe tip contains several isolated dark circular islets (mottling) within the white field. The right lobe tip features high-intensity fields bisected by vertical dark linear disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 125 degrees; the depth of the notch is approximately 1/8th of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels. Serrations appear more pronounced and jagged on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating at the median notch sweeping upward towards the distal tips; terminal ends exhibit a sharp convex transition at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected dark circular pixel clusters on the white background of the left distal tip and along the lower margin of the right distal tip, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, roughly vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the distal white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the right lobe tip; significant irregular chipping/serration along the trailing edge boundary.
